title: The New CCC Program
author: Zombie Containment (ZC) Labs Inc
pages: We are proud to announce our new Contain, Capture, and Cure (CCC) program!

Our agents will travel across the world to take zombie villagers and ill villagers to our labs. This removes sick individuals as a threat from their communities and allows us to study them to develop better medicine.
If you see our agents at night, do not go near them, they might be conducting a dangerous mission.
Finally, if you believe yourself to be turning, please surrender yourself to the nearest ZC Labs agent. You might wound up killing someone or getting killed without being taken to a safe place.
We appreciate your cooperation in advance! ZC Labs knows that this program will save so many lives!
